capabilities: Author five question types (single, multi, match, blank, essay) as plain Markdown blocks
Render quiz blocks as interactive answerable cards in reading view
Write attempt stats and history back into each question's quiz block
Practise whole question banks in a practice window with filters and shuffling
Supply an AI authoring spec (SKILL.md) so agents can write or repair question banks
extras: The README warns that the card UI, insert dialog, write-back, and practice window have not been verified inside a real Obsidian instance, though the logic layer is covered by tests. Interface ships in English and Chinese. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to author quizzes as plain Markdown, answer them in place, and keep attempt history inside the vault.
summary: Markdown-native quiz plugin that renders questions written in notes as interactive cards and writes attempt records back into the note.
